run: set -eux; gh_version=2.103.3; case "$(dpkg --print-architecture)" in amd64) gh_sha256=e3bafef96328d1a67de3a968bdfe1cc2ffd58cf6aba8b5e201356897ed06bb3d ;; arm64) gh_sha256=cac3ff84b60b68e64cca69f31f303210c26320361cc3286b773655d4226b7b06 ;; *) echo "unsupported gh architecture: $(dpkg --print-architecture)" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; gh_deb="/tmp/gh_${gh_version}_linux_$(dpkg --print-architecture).deb"; curl -fsSL "https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/download/v${gh_version}/gh_${gh_version}_linux_$(dpkg --print-architecture).deb" -o "$gh_deb"; echo "$gh_sha256  $gh_deb" | sha256sum -c; dpkg -i "$gh_deb"; rm -f "$gh_deb"; gh --version | grep -F "gh version $gh_version"
